paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: : Tradeoff between and for different parameter combinations. We annotate each data point with its corresponding value.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between IDK error rate and IDK recall for four parameter combinations (with/without \(\mathcal{L}_{FP}\)-reg and fixed/adaptive \(\lambda\)), with each marker annotated by its \(\lambda\) value. The x-axis is labeled “IDK error rate,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.00 to 0.25 with numeric tick labels shown at about 0.05 intervals (0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25). The y-axis is labeled “IDK recall,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from about 0.1 up to about 0.7 with evenly spaced tick marks (approximately 0.1 increments). The blue series (“No \(\mathcal{L}_{FP}\)-reg, fixed \(\lambda\)”) is a solid line with “x” markers; it increases across the x-range, starting near (0.02, 0.09) at the point annotated 0.1 and ending near (0.25, 0.67) at the point annotated 0.5, with intermediate marked points around (0.05, 0.25), (0.09, 0.39), and (0.15, 0.55). The orange series (“With \(\mathcal{L}_{FP}\)-reg, fixed \(\lambda\)”) is also solid with “x” markers; it rises from about (0.02, 0.12) at 0.1 to about (0.17, 0.60) at 0.5, with intermediate points around (0.04, 0.24), (0.06, 0.35), and (0.10, 0.49). The green series (“No \(\mathcal{L}_{FP}\)-reg, adaptive \(\lambda\)”) is a dashed line with upward-triangle markers; it is shown with two points, one near (0.05, 0.26) and another near (0.20, 0.64), with the higher point annotated 0.5. The red series (“With \(\mathcal{L}_{FP}\)-reg, adaptive \(\lambda\)”) is a dashed line with upward-triangle markers; it is also shown with two points, increasing from about (0.02, 0.24) (annotated 0.2) to about (0.08, 0.63) (annotated 0.5).
